drafts.rationale: EV-O-A07 states a distinct policy capping how many original and retry executions a job may receive before further execution is forbidden.
drafts.subject: Orion job execution

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B07 specifies the wait that must elapse after a failed execution before a retry may start, including backoff and a maximum wait.
drafts.subject: Orion job execution

drafts.rationale: EV-O-C07 bounds how long an individual execution may run and requires a timed-out execution to be stopped and recorded as failed.
drafts.subject: Orion job execution

drafts.rationale: EV-O-D07 requires further deliveries of an already-active job id to be ignored without changing that job's state.
drafts.subject: Orion job delivery

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E07 defines how long Orion must remember a producer idempotency key and that a key may be treated as new after that period.
drafts.subject: Orion idempotency keys

drafts.rationale: EV-O-F07 sets how long a worker lease lasts from delivery and that expiry without renewal or release makes the job available to other workers.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: EV-O-G07 describes when a worker may renew a lease and that each renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the renewal moment.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H07 states that cancellation forbids starting later attempts but must not interrupt an attempt that is already running.
drafts.subject: Orion job cancellation

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I07 requires an automatic move to the dead-letter queue after the last unsuccessful attempt and forbids further execution unless the job is resubmitted.
drafts.subject: Orion job final failure

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J07 requires an operator escalation when three dead-letter events for one tenant occur within a one-hour window measured from the first event.
drafts.subject: Orion dead-letter events

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K07 guarantees FIFO execution only among jobs in the same queue partition and makes no ordering promise across partitions.
drafts.subject: Orion queue execution

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L07 requires audit events to be kept for thirty days after recording and allows deletion thereafter.
drafts.subject: Orion audit events

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A01 and EV-O-A02 require a job to be executed at most three times in total, with the first execution counting as one of those three.
From EV-O-A03 onward, including EV-O-A07, a job has one original execution followed by no more than three retries and must not be executed again after the third retry fails.

value.text: one original execution plus at most three retries

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B01 through EV-O-B04 require a wait of exactly five seconds before every retry, not shortened or lengthened by attempt number.
EV-O-B05 through EV-O-B07 replace the fixed wait with a 2-second first retry delay that doubles each time and must never exceed 30 seconds.

value.text: 2 seconds before the first retry, doubling before each later retry, capped at 30 seconds

drafts.rationale: EV-O-C01 requires a thirty-second timeout; EV-O-C02 and EV-O-C07 restate the same limit as half a minute, after which the execution is stopped and recorded as failed.
EV-O-D07 requires that while a job id is active, additional deliveries of that id are ignored without changing the active job.

value.text: Further deliveries with the same job id must be ignored and must not change the active job's state.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E07 requires each idempotency key to be retained for twenty-four hours after it is first seen, after which it may be forgotten.
EV-O-F01 through EV-O-F06 require a worker lease to last sixty seconds from delivery to the worker.
EV-O-F07 requires a worker lease to last ninety seconds from delivery, stating that sixty seconds was too short for cold-start workers.
EV-O-G07 allows renewal every thirty seconds while work is progressing and requires each renewal to extend the lease by the full lease duration from that moment.

value.text: A worker may renew every 30 seconds while progressing; each renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H07 forbids starting further attempts after cancel and requires an in-flight attempt to run to its own completion, failure, or timeout.

value.text: No future execution attempt may be started after cancellation; an already running attempt is not interrupted and runs to completion, failure, or timeout.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I07 requires automatic dead-letter placement after the final unsuccessful attempt and forbids further execution unless the job is explicitly resubmitted.

value.text: The job is automatically moved to the dead-letter queue and must not be executed again unless explicitly resubmitted.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J07 requires an operator escalation when three dead-letter events for one tenant fall within one hour measured from the first event.

value.text: Three dead-letter events for the same tenant within one hour, measured from the first of the three events, raise an operator escalation.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K07 guarantees first-in-first-out order only within a partition and makes no ordering promise across partitions.

value.text: FIFO execution order is guaranteed only among jobs in the same queue partition; no ordering guarantee exists between different partitions.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L07 requires audit events to be retained for thirty days after they are recorded, after which they may be deleted.
